description: Implementation of the amf_connection_manager class managing AMF connections, reconnections, and disconnections in a 5G network context.

classes.name: amf_connection_manager
classes.description: Manages AMF connections, reconnections, and disconnections, including handling connection loss and reconnection logic.

methods.name: connect_to_amf
methods.description: Initiates connection to AMF and signals success or failure via a promise.

methods.name: disconnect_amf
methods.description: Disconnects all active AMF connections asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_amf_connection_loss
methods.description: Handles loss of connection to a specific AMF by removing it from the connected set.

methods.name: reconnect_to_amf
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect to a specified AMF, updating relevant state and notifying the CU-CP.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the AMF connection manager, disconnecting all connections and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: is_amf_connected
methods.description: Checks if an AMF is connected based on PLMN or AMF index.

methods.name: handle_connection_setup_result
methods.description: Updates the connection status of an AMF based on setup result.

methods.name: plmn_to_amf_index
methods.description: Converts a PLMN identity to the corresponding AMF index.
